text: ABwaterwells provides R interface Alberta Water Well Information Database (AWWID) via OData web service. Large tables downloaded parallel chunks automatically converted imperial metric units.

title: Retrieval and Analysis of the Alberta Water Well Information Database
text: Pass field connection object directly awwid_tbl(). IDE tab-complete available table names — need type remember strings.
code: wells <- awwid_tbl(   con$wells,   select = c("gicwellid", "wellid", "longitude", "latitude"),   filter = "gicwellid gt 40000 and gicwellid lt 41000" )  reports <- awwid_tbl(   con$wellreports,   select = c("wellid", "wellreportid", "totaldepthdrilled"),   filter = "wellreportid gt 40000 and wellreportid lt 41000" )  lithologies <- awwid_tbl(   con$lithologies,   filter = "wellreportid gt 40000 and wellreportid lt 41000" )  head(lithologies) #> # A tibble: 6 × 9 #>   lithologyid wellreportid depth waterbearing colour material description    #>         <int>        <int> <dbl>        <int> <chr>  <chr>    <chr>          #> 1    12729337        40914   219            0 Gray   Till     Stoney         #> 2    12729338        40914   229            0 <NA>   Gravel   Dirty          #> 3    12729339        40914   260            0 Gray   Till     Stoney         #> 4    12729340        40914   274            0 <NA>   Sand     Coarse Grained #> 5    12729341        40915    65            0 Gray   Till     Soft           #> 6    12729342        40915    85            0 <NA>   Sand     Dirty          #> # ℹ 2 more variables: createtimestamp <chr>, updatetimestamp <chr>

title: Retrieval and Analysis of the Alberta Water Well Information Database
text: programmatic use — iterating variable set table names — pass character string awwid_tbl() directly, index connection object [[:
code: tables_to_download <- c("wells", "wellreports", "lithologies")  results <- lapply(tables_to_download, function(tbl) {   awwid_tbl(con[[tbl]], top = 100) }) names(results) <- tables_to_download

title: Retrieval and Analysis of the Alberta Water Well Information Database
text: Data AWWID stored imperial units. Call metricate() convert table automatically:

title: Retrieval and Analysis of the Alberta Water Well Information Database
text: Several multi-table queries cover common workflows. accepts already- downloaded, metricated tables arguments, control downloads happen can reuse data across calls.

code: awwid_tbl(table, ...)  # S3 method for class 'awwid_table' awwid_tbl(   table,   filter = NULL,   select = NULL,   top = NULL,   chunk_size = 10000L,   .progress = FALSE )  # S3 method for class 'character' awwid_tbl(   table,   filter = NULL,   select = NULL,   top = NULL,   chunk_size = 10000L,   .progress = FALSE )

title: Fetch AWWID data from the AEPA OData server — awwid_tbl
text: table `awwid_table` descriptor [awwid_connect()], character string naming table. filter OData filter expression select rows server-side. select character vector columns return. default columns returned. top integer, return first n rows. chunk_size integer, number rows per download chunk paginating. Reducing value forces chunking small tables, useful testing. .progress logical, show progress bar downloading chunks.
